$comment: DRAFT — standards layer. Facts only: nominals, spec-defined ranges, and
engineering correlations. No art direction lives here; that is the variation
layer. This file is what backs the claim 'based on accepted engineering and
architectural standards', so anything in it must be citable.
This covers the sign INSTALLATION. The sign FACE is already handled by
config/signs_library.csv, which carries width per size class plus a
size_source provenance column — this file follows the same convention.
⚠ VERIFY BEFORE USE. Values marked "confidence": "unverified" are from
recall, not from a copy of the MUTCD. They are placed here so the schema is
concrete, NOT because they are trustworthy. Jordan: check them against the
actual manual before any of this ships or drives geometry.
Units are METRES throughout. Houdini is unitless, so the contract is stated
rather than assumed. Imperial originals are kept alongside because the
standards are written in feet and inches and the round numbers live there —
2.1 m is a rounding of 7 ft, and the 7 is the real figure.

MUTCD.title: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices
MUTCD.edition: TODO — pin the edition; figures move between them
MUTCD.note: Chapter 2A covers general sign placement: mounting height, lateral offset, orientation.

engineering.title: Derived from structural practice, not a single document
engineering.note: Correlations such as footing size scaling with pole height.

us_roadside_urban.label: US roadside sign, urban
us_roadside_urban.description: Post-mounted sign beside a street with kerb, footway and pedestrian movement.

mount_height.label: Bottom of sign above grade
mount_height.rationale: Raised clear of pedestrians where a footway is present.

lateral_offset.label: Face of kerb to near edge of sign

post_diameter.label: Post outside diameter
post_diameter.rationale: Typical U-channel or round steel post for a single conventional sign.

yaw_from_road.label: Face rotation away from perpendicular
yaw_from_road.rationale: Slight turn away from square reduces specular headlight glare on retroreflective sheeting.

correlations.rationale: Embedment scales with post size and exposed sail area. A pole that grows without its footing is the classic tell of independent jitter.

us_roadside_rural.label: US roadside sign, rural
us_roadside_rural.description: Post-mounted sign on a shoulder with no footway.

mount_height.rationale: Lower where there is no pedestrian traffic to clear.

lateral_offset.rationale: Measured from the edge of the shoulder rather than a kerb face.

us_overhead_freeway.label: US overhead guide sign, freeway gantry
us_overhead_freeway.description: Guide sign carried over the carriageway on a truss or cantilever.

vertical_clearance.label: Roadway surface to underside of sign
vertical_clearance.rationale: Clearance for legal vehicle height plus tolerance.

correlations.rationale: Slenderness stays roughly constant; a tall thin gantry reads as wrong immediately.
